title: Crofter Hand Woven Harris Tweed Co Ltd v Veitch

content.caseIdentity: Crofter Hand Woven Harris Tweed Co Ltd v Veitch, [1942] AC 435
content.facts: Concerted action alone is insufficient; the claimant must prove the required purpose or unlawful means and causative damage.
questionsBeforeCourt: What legal rule governs the doctrine?
content.ratioDecidendi: Concerted action alone is insufficient; the claimant must prove the required purpose or unlawful means and causative damage.
content.holding: Concerted action alone is insufficient; the claimant must prove the required purpose or unlawful means and causative damage.
content.relevance: Apply the ratio to the proved facts.
